_doc: design/proposals/nhiem-vu-risk-to-earn.md 3.2. `standard` applies to every mission fight. M1..M7 are the extra rules a tier names (no cap on the count, Liam 13/10: N6 names five). Each rule is a dict of mods: enemy_dmg/elite_hp/boss_hp/normal_hp/elite_dmg multiply (normal_hp = non-elite non-boss monsters only, elite_dmg = elite dice only; HP and dice values round half up on the final number), extra_elite/spike_period_delta add, clock override REPLACES the Ascension clock (never stacks). min/max_ascension gate a rule the Ascension already grants (M3 below A9).
